Bold ink-black shadows, saturated electric cyan/cobalt blues, hot vermilion and orange, cream highlights, confident simplified painted shapes, crisp contours, visible gouache and airbrush brushwork and printed poster texture, matching reference. Not photoreal, not 3D render. No Star Wars characters/ships/logos; original Escape Velocity universe imagery. Portrait 2:3 fills canvas, no pre-applied edge fades, no text, titles, letters, borders or watermark. High resolution.
